ALM-000262 explicitly states the BATTERY_LOW alarm was raised at 03:15 and cleared at 04:44 on S-SAH-009.
ALM-000263 explicitly states the SITE_DOWN alarm was raised at 03:30 and cleared at 04:44 on S-SAH-009.
T5 shows availability_pct series for S-SAH-001 and S-SAH-006 as 100 for all buckets in the window.
